candidate_generation.ddl_template: CREATE STATISTICS public."{statistic_name}" (mcv) ON "{catalog_column_i}", "{catalog_column_j}" FROM public.{table}; ALTER STATISTICS public."{statistic_name}" SET STATISTICS 300;
candidate_generation.object_kind: MCV only; plain table columns; no expressions
candidate_generation.source: Issue #99 frozen Train candidate-map.json per completed collection run
candidate_generation.universe: all unordered pairs of distinct columns in frozen schema_columns, mapped to zero-based candidate IDs e{left:02d}_{right:02d}

candidate_map_hash_semantics: Issue #99 candidate_map_sha256 is SHA-256 of compact JSON bytes from candidate rows with ensure_ascii=True, separators=(",", ":"); raw runtime file-byte SHA-256 is recorded separately.
